faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for MCA at St. Joseph Engineering College?
faqs.answer: St. Joseph Engineering College offers a two-year MSc course at the PG level. As per the minimum eligibility requirements of the course, candidates must pass a UG degree with minimum 50% aggregate in the relevant discipline.

faqs.question: Does St. Joseph Engineering College offer MCA course?
faqs.answer: Yes, St. Joseph Engineering College offers an MCA course for a duration of two years. The college admission is entirely entrance-based. To be eligible for admission, Applicants must pass graduation in the relevant stream to be eligible to apply for the course.

faqs.question: How does St. Joseph Engineering College select students for admission?
faqs.answer: St. Joseph Engineering College admission is entrance-based. To proceed with filling out the application form, candidates must visit the official website of St. Joseph Engineering College and apply for the desired course. Additionally, applicants must apply and appear for the national level entrance exam including the CMAT, KMAT, GATE, and COMEDK UGET among others. Based on eligibility and a good score in the entrance exam it will be easy to grab a seat.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Supportive faculty, good labs, and campus, but limited placements and mostly off-campus internships.

review_content.Placements: 30 out of 140 students from our course get placed through campus recruitment, translating to a placement rate of 21 percent. The highest package offered is 5 LPA while the lowest is 3 LPA with an average package of 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Mirafra, Infosys, Karmik, Brevera and Light Mechanics. When it comes to internships almost all students secure internships although the majority are off campus. Only 20 students receive on campus internship offers. Companies such as Brevera, Karmik and Mirafra provide on campus internship opportunities. The top roles offered to students are in VLSI design, Digital Electronics, and Embedded Systems.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: The best college from my experience.

review_content.Placements: There is a good demand for placements. Students also get trained for their skills at all levels. Above 50 companies come in for the campus selection. Around more than 60% of eligible students got placed every year. A list of companies would be Infosys, TCS, Microsoft, Cognizant, Wipro, Amazon, HP, Mphasis, SAP, Decathlon, Tech Mahindra, Bosch, Capgemini, Citrix, and VMware to name a few.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel provides a good study environment and a fun environment side by side. As per the classmates, both girls hostel and boys hostels are very good. The monthly rent is Rs. 2500 per person. There are 2 sharing rooms. They provide 24-hour free Wi-Fi and nice toilets. Rooms are cleaned every day.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Review of St. Joseph's Engineering College.

review_content.Placements: I think 60% and above of students get placed, and my course is Computer Science and Data Science. The top recruiting company is Wipro, along with other similar companies. The percentage of students who get internships from our course is above 80%, but the waiting time is longer than expected.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are very clean and well-maintained. They provide us with good facilities, and faculty members are friendly and understanding, except for a few. However, the hostel food is very bad. We get the same type of sambar every noon. The wardens do not always understand us, and the hostel needs improvement.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Really impressed with campus and faculty.

review_content.Placements: Placements have been excellent, but very low packages are offered by companies. The lowest package is approximately 3.5 lacs per annum, whereas the highest package goes for about 25 lacs per annum. Overall, many companies come for recruitment, where they conduct aptitude tests, technical rounds, and then interviews.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are pretty spacious and breezy. The course that I've taken has been pretty good so far, with quite a few interesting subjects related to my field. Regarding the hostel, it's pretty good. The food is nice for dinner. Lunch is very basic.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: The campus is very beautiful.

review_content.Placements: College doesn't provide any internship opportunity but keeps posting and emailing all the students about all the latest and highly recommended internships available for students and encourages students to take part in it. The college keeps internships and projects for students in every semester. Students are asked to work using subjects other than the core subjects so that we learn and improve our knowledge in every field.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are an uncountable number of events held in the college in which one can also or should take part, and a Tech Fest is held every year in May, and in December, a traditional get-together for new students is held. Huge library with all books and reading space too. Projectors, well-furnished classrooms, and 9 fans in each class. Many clubs for students to take part in and increase their thinking skills. Sports Day is also conducted every year, which may vary according to academics and can be held in time of the year.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: The campus is situated in a very quite place away from the city.

review_content.Placements: College doesn't provide any internship opportunity but keeps posting and emailing all the students about all the latest and highly recommended internships available for students and encourages students to take part in it. Students are eligible for campus placements from the 4th semester itself, and the companies visiting our campus are in great numbers.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are an uncountable number of events held in the college in which one can also or should take part, and a tech fest is held every year in May, and in December, a traditional get-together for new students is held. Huge library with all books and reading space too. Projectors, well-furnished classrooms, and 9 fans in each class. Many clubs for students to take part in and increase their thinking skills. Sports Day is also conducted every year, which may vary according to academics and can be held in time of the year.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by St Aloysius' CollegeReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: BBA at St Aloysius' College.
reviews.review_text: The classroom is well maintained with a smartboard, with Wi-Fi available, and well equipped library. The hostel is not good, as I have heard the rooms are bad with bad hygiene and bad food for the students. The fees they take are high too, so much for students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology and ScienceReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Facilities are good, the study in this college is the best. In the case of placement, it's average.
reviews.review_text: The library is present, and the labs are there. No hostel facility, 2 canteens are available. Sports kota is present, but Wi-Fi and solar facilities are not available in my college. Some classrooms have no AC. Very difficult to suffer in the summer season.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by St Aloysius' CollegeReviewed on 7 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: I was kind of okay with the college not so good, not so bad. Still, I enjoyed my college life mostly
reviews.review_text: There were smart classes with good decorum, and the teachers were actually good. There was real discipline in the classes. As I stay in Jabalpur, I don't know about their hostels. There was Wi-Fi available. I heard the food in the hostel was average.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by St Aloysius' CollegeReviewed on 6 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classes and labs are renovated and good from my second year but in first year they are not that good only average. The new classes are very good. I do not stay in hostel so I can't say anything about it. There is a nurse's office, and some sports are available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology and ScienceReviewed on 1 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with the college infrastructure. Placements are good then but now college.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, classrooms are also okay. Library condition is well sports and games opportunity is also provided but hostel conditions are not that good. The canteen food is of good quality is also good medical staff present there for the full day. The department is good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by St Aloysius' CollegeReviewed on 29 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: About the nature of teachers and the seniors.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very good, and the meal quality of the mess is very good and delicious. There are many facilities that are provided in the room, such as 24/7 electricity and a bed. It has a good and friendly environment. The registration is done through our college, and the affordability is also very good, which comprises Rs. 20,000 per year. Hostel fee is Rs. 20,000 per year.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology and ScienceReviewed on 24 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good management.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are quite good. Free Wi-Fi is available in labs, and the overall infrastructure is good. The library is quite good. The quality of food in the canteen is nice. Labs are big with no issues. My library experience is not very good because of a fine. Sports and games happen from time to time, and the AIML department is also good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by St Aloysius' CollegeReviewed on 22 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The library of our college and reading room are very good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is within the campus for UG where the fee for a year is 75000 and increases year by year. Here, we get a room, and all are two sharing rooms. There is a list of things we have to bring on our own. The food is okay, we can't complain about it they serve good food. Hostel fee is INR 75,000 per year.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Shri Ram Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 21 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good but not a value for money college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is decent. There are facilities of a water cooler in the department and AC in all classrooms for cooling. Classrooms are quite good. Wi-Fi is available only in labs, and the systems are decent. College library is good, all the courses and other books are available in the library, and a huge space for sitting is provided by the library.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by St Aloysius' CollegeReviewed on 18 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is top-notch.
reviews.review_text: In our college, hostel rooms were available for girls, not for boys. I lived in a room in Bholaram in Bhawarkua, Indore. The quality of food was good. We registered to call them and registered for a room. The rent was Rs 6,500 per month, except for electricity and other cleaning stuff.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology and ScienceReviewed on 5 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: A good engineering college in Jabalpur.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are quite good, and the infrastructure is also good. The quality of food in the canteen is also nice, and the labs are big, no problem. The library experience is very good in my case because I can sit there for study by bunking the class, and the sports and games also happen, and the AIML department is also nice. But the CSE department is too awesome.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology and ScienceReviewed on 2 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with a good environment and good internships.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are a little good in our department. The infrastructure is good. The quality of food in the canteen is also nice. Labs are big, and there is no problem. The library experience is also good. Sports and games also happen. The AI ML department is also nice. There are some free Wi-Fi connections also.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by St Aloysius' CollegeReviewed on 30 Nov 2025)

paragraphs: Find below the complete process aroundNIT Agartala admission 2025:
NIT Agartala Application Process

Students seeking admission at NIT Agartala are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. Students have toapplyfor the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to MBA, MA and PhD courses must are required to apply through the official website.
Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Agartala admits students with a validJEE Mainscore. Seats are alloted through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Agartala MBA admissions are done through MAT, CAT, and CMAT scores, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Agartala cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respectivecounsellingbodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

NIT Agartala fees for all UG & PG courses include components such as tuition fees, hostel fees and one-time fee payments. Similarly, a total of 2,000+ seats are available for overall courses. reviews.review_heading: College is overall good. If you get better branch only then join it. Otherwise don't.
reviews.review_text: As my branch is Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, I have to study in the same building as CSE branch building. Infrastructure of classroom, labs and library are good. With AC in library, but only problem is Wi-Fi. Sometimes we are able to use Wi-Fi. Sometimes can't.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and one of the most beautiful NITs.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is very good. Facilities provided here are Wi-Fi, water, and a lift all of which are very good except the mess for the first year, but it also becomes good as you enter the second year. There is a huge sports complex with all the facilities like a basketball court, badminton court, table tennis, gym, swimming pool, etc.

reviews.review_heading: About NIT, how it will be.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was very good. The campus had fast Wi-Fi and many grounds and sports rooms. There were many different types of departments on the campus. The quality of the hostel was also good, and in the canteen, the food quality was okay, but it could be improved.

reviews.review_heading: The best college across India for placement and college life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities were excellent in every department. We had multiple labs, fast Wi-Fi, and a big library. Hostel facilities were also good. We had big grounds for different sports and games. The food quality was also good, but it could be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college.
reviews.review_text: There is a big library on the campus with enough books for every subject, and literature and novels are also available. Classrooms depend on the building in which your classes are held. Science block classes are not very good, but in the CSE and the new freshers’ building started this year, the classrooms are very good. There are a lot of clubs. In the hostel, there are two beds in a room with double accommodation, tube lights, and fans. The food is average, but the quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: First qualify, then dream about this college.
reviews.review_text: There is a big library on the campus with enough books for every subject, and literature and novels are also available. Classrooms depend on the building in which your classes are going on, like science block classes are not good, but in the CSE and a new freshers building, which was started this year, for the first year, we are having very good classes. Here are a lot of clubs. In the hostel, there are two beds in a room as this is double accommodation, tubelights, fan, covered, food is average...

reviews.review_heading: Prasenjit Das college review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in this course were so good. Wi-Fi and classroom were available in my college. The quality of food in college canteen was so superb. Medical facility was not good. All sports and games were available for all students in my course.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Agartala is getting better, but due to its locality, its development will take time.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of NIT Agartala is good. Wi-Fi is available everywhere with a daily 2 GB Jionet. Classrooms are also cleaned with daily washing. Libraries are also big with the maximum number of books available. The quality of facilities in the hostel is not that good. The food quality is not good. Canteen's food is also not good. Medical facilities are average. Sports exposure is below average, with vast sporting games played here.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, placement is not that good, really, infrastructure and facilities are very good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my college is good, the classrooms are good, the labs are also very good, and there are many things in the labs. The Wi-Fi facility of my college is very fast, but the quality of the mess food is not good. The food is too oily. There is a hospital in our college, which is open 24 hours. The sports section is very good, every game is there as per your wish, and you can participate.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. You should take admission in this college.
reviews.review_text: NIT Agartala occupies around 365 acres of campus, set in a serene environment with well-planned academic blocks and greenery. The institute offers modern classrooms, seminar halls, and a lecture theatre equipped with projectors and other audiovisual aids. Labs are well-equipped across departments, including computer labs, electronics, mechanical, civil, etc., supporting hands-on learning. The central library has a large collection (several tens of thousands of books), many journals (200), plus d...

reviews.review_heading: About good placements (75%) with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In hostel room, 2 students share a single room. In room, two beds, two tube lights, one ceiling fan, one table, one chair, and one almirah are available. Mess food is average. Three times a week give chicken, two times egg at night. Classrooms are cleaned. Library is quite big and books are available.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, but the hostel and mess food are problematic.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the hostel are average, and the food is also not that good. Wi-Fi here is bad, too. Canteen, we have a Nescafe, but there are only a few items available. Classrooms are of average quality. Lawns are pretty good too, and medical facilities are active 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, as it is NIT. Hostels are well-maintained, and the mess food is good. First-year students stay in the RNT hostel. We also have a hospital also in our campus. We have a very large sports complex. There are lots of mess and canteens available all over the campus.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Agartala College Review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was practical, with good facilities both for sports and academics. You could always use a LAN port for an unlimited public Ethernet connection. The campus was full of well organized events, and the different clubs add to the diversity and opportunities for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Overall great college and nice campus.
reviews.review_text: Good and clean hostels are there. Our college has good atmosphere and very nice to spend time here. The courses are very great. There are 10 different branches that offer you to learn deep engineering. Very good and nice campus as well. I recommend taking admission to this college.

admission_process.title: AGBS Kochi Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Ranked among the top 10 business schools in India, AGBS is a leader in providing management studies at UG and PG level.AGBS Kochiprovides extensive corporate exposure to students. Admission at both UG and PG level is done based on performance in qualifying exam, English essay and interview. For PG programme, direct admissions are also provided which are merit-based and the score obtained in national level examinations such asCAT/MAT/XAT/ATMATo apply for various programmes, candidates have both online and offline options to fill the application forms.

The School offers GDBA+BBA and PGPM+MBA programmes along with flex mode BBA and MBA programmes in affiliation withAmity University. Find below the eligibility and selection for the courses offered by AGBS Kochi:
English Essay Test + Interview

AGBS admission is a multi-step process that involves form filling, Interview and English Test, Release of Merit list, counselling and lastly admission confirmation. The steps for the course admissions are as follows:
1: AGBS Indore Application Process 2025
The application form is released online on the official website. Eligible candidates can register and apply. The applications must be submitted on or before the prescribed deadline.
2: Selection Rounds
Selection criteria for the PG courses is based the qualifying exam scores. The selected students have to take part in the interview and an English proficiency test.
3: Merit List
After selection, a merit list is released. It mentions the minimum required score in the specific exam and the interview.
4: Counselling

Then the selected students have to take part in counselling four seat allocation. Some of the parameters that are considered includes merit, eligibility, and performance in the interview and English test.
5: Admission Confirmation
After the seat allocation, the fees can be paid for admission. The class commencement details are then provided by the college.

content.Placements: I have got 73 percent in B.Com. My package is 50000 and I was offered many courses. I suggest that everyone should take admission in this college it is the number one college in India and Rajasthan with the best education to help make your future bright.
content.Infrastructure: The transport facilities, hostel facilities, food, and many more amenities can't be explained enough; this is the best college according to my experience. It also has a big playground. I suggest that everyone should take admission in this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with 2015 campus placements.

content.Placements: No campus placements are conducted in the college. There were around 60 students in each branch, and no company was communicated for campus placement. None of the students got an internship from college, and all students did an internship on their own. College does not provide placements.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs and library were in good condition. Food in a mess used to be unhygienic and lacked good quality. No inter-college sports competitions were conducted. In the library, there were only a few books. No medical and sports facilities were provided in the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied because of no placement.

content.Placements: There were no placements as the college was about to close in 2018 after their last batch. The college placement officer had left the college before the last batch of engineering was about to complete. The college suffered through many up's and down's.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was good and well built but, due to lack of students it was hard to maintain the property. Labs had proper equipments. No Wi-Fi available for students it was only accessible at college computers. Library was good having the necessary books.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: I am very disappointed with Jodhpur National University.

content.Placements: There were no placements for my batch and also our senior batch because our college was blacklisted. It happened because our chairman has given wrong admissions and had done wrong work on the campus. The management of our college was also not supportive of placements and other things.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is huge spreading over 1000 acres. Classrooms were not well-designed, and the facilities were not good as the green boards and seats were broken. No Wi-Fi facility is available on the campus. Labs are good, but the lab operators are not available properly. The library has a less number of books. There is no sports room nor games. Overall, I am not happy with the college.

faqs.question: Can I become a lawyer without a Law degree?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot become a lawyer without a Law degree.You mandatorily need to obtain degrees such as BA/BCom/BSc/BBA LLB or LLB in order to be a lawyer in India. To become a lawyer, one must first complete three-year or five-year LLB from a recognised university and possess degree certificate. Then, they must enrol themselves in local Bar Council of the concerned state and enrolled as an advocate. Within two years of the enrolment, they must appear and clear AIBE in order to be eligible to practise anywhere in India.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jodhpur National University.
reviews.review_text: There are six semesters of taught courses, including a summer internship. The total credit for the programmes is 140, which is equivalent to 26 courses. Each credit represents 1 hour of classroom teaching per week and 15 hours in a semester. Hostel accommodation is provided separately for boys and girls. The infrastructure of the hostels is good, and the rooms are double-sharing and well-furnished. Maintenance services are provided, and the mess food, as well as Wi-Fi, is also good.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in all of India.
reviews.review_text: The transport facilities, hostel facilities, food, and many more amenities can't be explained enough; this is the best college according to my experience. It also has a big playground. I suggest that everyone should take admission in this college.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with 2015 campus placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs and library were in good condition. Food in a mess used to be unhygienic and lacked good quality. No inter-college sports competitions were conducted. In the library, there were only a few books. No medical and sports facilities were provided in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of no placement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was good and well built but, due to lack of students it was hard to maintain the property. Labs had proper equipments. No Wi-Fi available for students it was only accessible at college computers. Library was good having the necessary books.

reviews.review_heading: I am very disappointed with Jodhpur National University.
reviews.review_text: The campus is huge spreading over 1000 acres. Classrooms were not well-designed, and the facilities were not good as the green boards and seats were broken. No Wi-Fi facility is available on the campus. Labs are good, but the lab operators are not available properly. The library has a less number of books. There is no sports room nor games. Overall, I am not happy with the college.

reviews.review_heading: You can join the college, but it's not worth it..
reviews.review_text: As far as the infrastructure is concerned, we have all the facilities. The Wi-Fi facility was available but was paid. We had all the sports facilities like badminton, cricket, table tennis etc. Rooms provided to us were good in terms of quality, and they were spacious. Food served in the canteen was good.

reviews.review_heading: This is the West Rajasthan deemed private university.
reviews.review_text: Jodhpur National University infrastructure is average. There is no proper branch building. There are three to four branches in one building. In the laboratory, all the equipment is not available. This university is located outside the city, and the transportation system is not good. The hostel management is poor, and they provide low quality food.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the freedom and over friendly faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Here, Wi-Fi labs, classrooms, library, medical hospital, restrooms, football ground, cricket ground, badminton court, basketball court, garden, cafeteria, laundry, hostel facilities, vegetarian mess, common room, a Wi-Fi enabled hostel and a good number of cadavers are present.

reviews.review_heading: Completely fed up with college placements. The only good thing is faculty, otherwise, a full waste
reviews.review_text: In our college, the infrastructure was average. The lab facility and the library are good. We are getting books for a long duration. Talking about the canteen and the hostel, they are the same as all colleges. The canteen food was not so hygienic and costly too. Hostel rooms are average as they are very old. Labs and classrooms are average. In the lab, limited pieces of equipment were there so we need to share. In the computer lab, we need to share the computer. Classrooms were big but fully unf...

reviews.review_heading: Bad placements, but the infrastructure is good and you have to do everything on your own.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was huge but not properly managed. The college has a canteen with really good food. There are separate boys and girls hostel. The mess food is really good, especially the breakfast. You can eat in the mess secretly even if you are not staying in the hostel. It has a good big hospital with all the modern facilities and also has a medical shop inside the campus. The college transportation facilities are very good and they have many buses. You can find shops outside the campus al...

reviews.review_heading: It is an average university with average faculty, where the management wasn't up to the mark at all.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was huge but not well-maintained. The washrooms were not clean and neither were they cleaned on a regular basis. The classrooms were not comfortable enough for the students as well. They had grounds huge enough to play any kind of sport but they were also not maintained. The canteen was small and the food quality was also not good.

reviews.review_heading: No placement was there.I think placement is the most important thing which matters.
reviews.review_text: No sports faculty and coach available. The infrastructure is typical Rajasthani building surrounded by sand. The inside infrastructure is more or less ok. In the summers, it creates problems for students to sit inside the classroom because there is no AC, no cooler. Only fan is there.

reviews.review_heading: If you are still in this college and you are reading this then follow the NPTEL videos.
reviews.review_text:
The Wi-Fi is good, but you have to pay Rs 200 or more per month, and most of the sites are blocked. 
In the lab, you can get resistors, capacitors or two-three CROs which will be inaccurate, and any other thing is not available.
The classrooms are without any facility like no projector, light and fan problem always, with no laptop charging point.
The medical facilities are like you have to pay every time just like a private clinic.
For sports, there is only 1 badminton court but no net facility.

reviews_list.review_title: DBIMSCA - best for enjoyment and freedom.

review_content.Placements: Only 5-10% of students get placed every year through the recruitment process. The highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA. Mahindra, IBM, Link Digital, Jio Telecommunications, and Infosys are the top companies that visit for recruitment. Our college does not assist in getting internships as we have to find them on our own and submit the reports to the college. International Sales Specialist, Sales Specialist, Relationship Manager, and Marketing Head are the top roles offered in our course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The Commerce Department has two buildings, one basketball ground, one cricket ground, a cafeteria, three computer labs, two libraries, a combined hostel, and a park. The infrastructure is excellent and completely student-friendly. However, the hostel is not very good considering the fee of Rs 1,30,000 per year. The food is okay, and the rooms are quite decent, but it may not be affordable for all students. The paid food in the cafeteria and canteen is good and reasonably priced. We are free to choose any sport we like and receive get trained in it.

admission_process.title: Rohini College of Engineering and Technology Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Rohini College of Engineering and Technology admission 2025is entrance-based. The college offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programmes in the fields of Engineering, Management, Computer Application, etc. To get admission toRohini College of Engineering and Technology, one must meet the eligibility criteria set by the college. The admission can be done through the Tamilnadu government counselling quota and management quota. Also known asRCET, the college offers courses in affiliation withAnna University. Interested candidates can read the following article to learn all about the courses offered at the college and their respective admission criteria.

RCET course admissionsare based on merit/ entrance exam scores. Along with that, candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements of the respective courses. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularRohini College of Engineering and Technology courses:

Rohini College of Engineering and Technology admission process includes registration for the entrance exam, TNEA counselling, TANCET score etc. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat in RCET:
STEP 1: Application Process
Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the institute. Candidates must pay the application fee as per respective courses.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

Students will be selected based on Merit + TNEA counselling, GATE, CEETA and TANCET, TANCET MBA, MAT, and CAT scores as per respective courses. Additionally, clearing the minimum eligibility criteria as specified by the college. Students can apply either via the Tamil Nadu government counselling quota or management quota.
STEP 3: Merit List andAdmission Confirmation
Once selection rounds are over, the institute releases a merit list. To confirm the seat candidates are required to pay the application fee at the admission receipt centre.

reviews.review_heading: MCA from the Rohini College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in this college are of good quality. The college has furnished classrooms with digital boards and air conditioning. Wi-Fi is available on campus for students. The labs are equipped with proper computer systems for coding practice. A canteen facility is also available, offering good food.

reviews.review_heading: Student at Rohini college of engineering and technology.
reviews.review_text: There is a large stadium present within our college campus. Our students have won 20+ trophies from university tournaments. There is a specific menu to be followed every day. There is a big, spacious library on our campus for research and studying.

reviews.review_heading: Rohini College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: It was really a highly advanced classroom with a well-developed infrastructure. Our buildings were too constructive, with well-experienced faculty members. The foods available at our canteen and hostel mess are very tasty, and they are acceptable to eat. We are asked to concentrate on our interests in sports.

reviews.review_heading: Rohini college of engineering and technology.
reviews.review_text: Our canteens are served with high quality foods. The overall infrastructure of our college was really good. There are separate hostel blocks for boys and girls students. There is a big stadium present within our campus. There is an enhanced security system within the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Rohini college of engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was excellent: air-conditioned classrooms with experienced faculty members. Apart from that, it was an environmentally friendly organization. They plant saplings once a month, and it was a hygienic campus where food of high quality, tasty to eat, is served.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Kanyakumari District.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Our college has good environment and atmosphere. All classrooms are huge. We have lab facilities. The food served in our college is good. All subject-related books are available in the library.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college for Kanyakumari and Tirunelveli surrounded students.
reviews.review_text: I'm not a hosteller in my college but my friends are used to coming from the hostel. The infrastructure is nice and the food is tasty most of the time. And the food is always available for the hostellers they have the same canteen for day scholars. Not much bad reviews about the hostel in my college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a good infrastructure. Its location and facilities are up to the mark.
reviews.review_text: It has the best infrastructure in Kanyakumari. It offers Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a centralised library, a cafeteria, a grand arena, a clock tower, various blocks, a store, a gym, separate hostels for girls and boys, mess halls, sports, and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good infrastructure and excellent faculty members.
reviews.review_text: In our college, we have very good laboratories. Our college provides a good environment to learn and involve in sports activities allowing us to participate in all other cultural activities, etc.

reviews.review_heading: This is a good college in our district.
reviews.review_text: In this college, Wi-Fi is available on our campus. Laboratories, classrooms, and libraries are very clean and effective. The library has several books. Lots of author books are available in our college, and the laboratories are very secure and skilled laboratory assistants are there in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Very much satisfied with the faculty, placements, infrastructure, and transport facilities.
reviews.review_text: Rohini College is the only best college in Nagercoil and Kanyakumari area. This is a very new college when compared to other colleges in Kanyakumari, so the infrastructure is very modernised. The college is providing free Wi-Fi facility to all the students on the campus. Apart from that, they have four separate rooms only for medical facilities, and there is a doctor appointed who is available 24 hours. Rohini College has a basketball court, a volleyball court, and 200-metres and 400-metre runni...

reviews.review_heading: The college provides excellent facilities, faculty members, infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Rohini is the only engineering college in Kanyakumari which is providing free Wi-Fi facility for students throughout the campus. We have big libraries with more than 75,000 books. Apart from this, the college has provided excellent transportation facilities and canteens, etc. Rohini College has a small medical store with first-aid on the campus. A very big multi-speciality hospital is available near our college. They provide separate hostels for boys and girls. Security guards are available to w...

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, but management makes fake promises and advertisements.
reviews.review_text: Founder of the college is a local businessman they have a large amount of black money, so he decided to tally their black money properly so the management founded the trust and built the engineering college, In our state, every engineering college is a bane for large amount student. All politicians have their engineering college. This college was started in 2013, so the infrastructure classrooms are in good condition, they also provide the Wi-Fi facility to the students and collected fee for tha...

reviews.review_heading: Compared to other colleges in Kanniyakumari, our college is good.
reviews.review_text: We have good college infrastructure. The hostel food is average. Our labs are well-equipped, and the canteen offers satisfactory food. We have good medical facilities and drinking water. The college provides high-level sports training and opportunities. However, the mess food has been quite poor for the hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Top-notch infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Loved the whole vibe of this college. Our campus is green and modern campus. It has nice auditorium. Sports facilities are awesome. It has a super clean campus. Labs and library are super well-equipped. Everything is so clean and well-maintained. The hostels feel really safe and home-like.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of college timings and exam schedule .
reviews.review_text: Overall, facilities are average, but the hostel has lighting issues and the food is sometimes not good. Medical facilities are good, and there is sports time in the evening. The campus is good and attractive; the hostel building is also good. Three B.Ed students share one room. There is a mess and a canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Skilled and experienced faculty members .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the International School of Management, Patna, is good, including air-conditioned classrooms. The library is also good. Hostel facilities are provided for both boys and girls, which are located near the college. The quality of the mess food is not good. Only one sick room is available for students.

reviews.review_heading: International School of Management Patna review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is really great. There is so much greenery all over the campus that makes it very beautiful. There are free Wi-Fi services. The canteen food is also very good. There is a variety of food items that are available in our canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Really good Infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: ISM Patna has good infrastructure, including separate hostels for boys and girls that are located near the college. Still the canteen facilities are not so good as the food is not prepared properly and there is a limited selection. The quality of the mess food is also just average.

reviews.review_heading: First of all, try to get admission to top colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here is very good, and the greenery has been maintained well, but no one is going to get any special benefit from this. The hostel facilities here are nothing special, and there is a great need for improvement because health is very important in one's life.

reviews.review_heading: The placement is very good in all years .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is just wow. The Bihar campus is one of the most beautiful in all. There is a library, computer labs are big, and Wi-Fi facilities are available for hostel students. The food provided by mess is also good, and a sports club is there.

reviews.review_heading: Overall review is that you can go to this college. Infrastructure is great, as are the faculties.
reviews.review_text: The college has a library where you can issue the books. It has 3 computers and language labs. The classrooms are air conditioned. Canteens are fresh. The hostel facility is there for girls and boys separately. Sports and games events happen on a regular basis.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but too much restrictions that you can't handle.
reviews.review_text: Fully AC, Wi-Fi campus. The classroom is also good. The library is good but does not have AC. We have an average campus for playing sports. Hostel and mess facilities are average here. Medical facilities are good; we have a sick room where we can rest if we feel sick, and medicine is also available for us.

reviews.review_heading: The International School of Management (ISM) is one of the best private colleges in Patna.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good for smart classes. BBA, BCA, B.J.M.C., and PGDM courses are available at our college. Proper labs, individual smart classes, big auditoriums, and hostels are also good with good food and security. A canteen is also available .

reviews.review_heading: The Best college in Bihar .
reviews.review_text: Our college provides hostel facility for both boys and girls the girls' hostel is on the college campus and the boys hostel is far from the college The facilities are average I must say the rooms are good and the food was not that good but it's okay. On-campus lab and other facilities are provided too.

reviews.review_heading: International School of Management Patna review .
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is excellent for boys and girls, both in one room; there are 3 boys are allowed and every room has an attached bathroom. The food quality is excellent and the menu is also good. Wi-Fi is always available for free. Mess timing is 8 am, 1 pm for lunch, 4 pm for snacks and 8 pm for dinner at night.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good but absolutely dissatisfied because of management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well developed and the classrooms are amazing in the first year, with fully air-conditioned rooms with projectors. Classes are taken by the faculty members with the help of projectors. The infrastructure of hostels is also good, and the canteens are well cleaned.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing International School of Management, Patna.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of International School of Management, Patna, is very beautiful and attractive too. At ISM, every course has a separate classroom having AC and fans. The college provides a Library, mess, canteen and cafeteria where various items of food are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculties, their teachings, good placements, and beautiful infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for my course department are library, labs, well-furnished classrooms with air conditioning, projectors, whiteboards, etc. The hostel quality is good, and the food is quite healthy and nutritious in our college.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best for study, practical knowledge, and good placement, with really good faculty.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, placement facility not good, infrastructure and hostel facility are perfect.

Food quality is good and different in the hostel. Cricket and football grounds are present on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfying infrastructure and environment.
reviews.review_text: There are a lot of rooms, about 30 for classes of different departments, equipped with air conditioning. There is Wi-Fi in every section of the college with good speed. The college library is so good, it has a wide variety of book collections. We can hire books for a few weeks.

reviews.review_heading: Abruptly satisfied with the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: There are a lot of rooms for classes of different departments equipped with air-conditioning. There is Wi-Fi in every section of the college with good speed. The college library is so good, it has a wide variety of book collections. We can also hire books for a few weeks.

reviews.review_heading: Shreeyash College of Engineering review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good enough. Wi-Fi facilities are available. Labs are well maintained and had all the instruments required for practicals. Modern classrooms and computer labs are available. The hostel quality of our college is okay. Basic medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty members and the lack of placements.
reviews.review_text: Our campus offers excellent facilities. Facilities like a cricket ground, a football ground, a basketball court, a clean and well-managed canteen, a well-stocked library, and a cozy student lounge that served as a great place to relax, study, and interact with fellow students during free time.

reviews.review_heading: It's absolutely good because of the faculty and campus, placement is average.
reviews.review_text: Campus is cool, and the quality of the hostel and college is not bad, with good maintenance. You should have sports activities too, but only during free times. The canteen of the college is famous.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the nature and college campus.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available but not for our personal use; it is given only if we do the college work they assign. The labs are good, all PCs are working well, and the classrooms are also very good. We have a whiteboard and a projector as well. I am not in the hostel, but I know from the girls that the mess is not good. In the mess, the food is like water, and the canteen is not good. The medical facility is not available, and games are 60-70% done.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for Mechanical Engineering Course in B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: A great educational environment is provided for students to study and help them to develop their skills. In my department, there are special computer labs to do practicals and to get the actual experience of theory subjects and learn more about them.

reviews.review_heading: Shreeyash College is a college of study nature.
reviews.review_text: The college offers well-equipped laboratories for various engineering disciplines, including computer labs with the latest software and hardware. The library is well-stocked with a wide range of books and provides a conducive environment for study. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, ensuring students have access to online resources. The college promotes sports and games, offering facilities for cricket, football, basketball, and indoor games, encouraging students to engage in physical act...

reviews.review_heading: Scope for improvement.
reviews.review_text: We have a very basic hostel. You'll be provided with a small cupboard, a bed, a mattress, a pillow, and a desk (if you are lucky) but I recommend getting your own pillow at least. Wouldn't complain about the mess food because it's decent based on the amount you are paying.

reviews.review_heading: College is average for B.Tech Mechanical Engineering, good campus, supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: There are neither poor nor good facilities, but average facilities available for Mechanical Engineering. There is a good internet connection on PCs, and labs are also average. Classrooms are good, and the library is also good. Hostel facilities are good, but the mess is very poor, and the food quality in the mess is very poor. The canteen is good. Medical facilities are available because there is a hospital on our college campus. For sports, there are large grounds available.

reviews.review_heading: All colleges in Aurangabad are doing such a scam, so be aware!
reviews.review_text: This is average but not so good. There are workshops, but they are not properly cleaned, and they do not give funding to projects of students. When I was in my final year, and I wanted to participate in ATVC, so that time when I went to my above department for funding, they couldn't pay, and when I gave them admission, they gave us funding when our competition is 10 days away.

reviews.review_heading: Shreeyash college of engineering & Technology .
reviews.review_text: College is located far away from main city, it surrounded by villages no Wi-Fi available, library was fine it have all kind of books, some classrooms have projector. MBA hostel is under construction we stayed in flats. Canteen food is very bad not tasty. Sports games are very limited.

reviews.review_heading: Green campus which is close to nature.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, laboratories, big classrooms with projectors in each class, libraries, etc. are there. The quality of food is amazing in our college canteen. We have good ground. And we play badminton, cricket and various other games whenever our lecture is off. We also have medical facilities if someone gets injured or ill.

Audyogik Shikshan Mandal (ASM) Group of Institutes was established in 1983. This group has more than seven institutes under it. One of the institutes, IIBR Pune is approved by AICTE, Government of India, and was promoted in 1995 by ASM in association with MCCIA. IIBR Pune offers PG courses to students. These courses are provided across Digital Marketing, Banking and Finance, and various other streams. The flagship programme available in the college is PGDM. IIBR Pune provides 100% placement assistance to students.

admission_process.title: IIBR Pune Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: The admission process forASM's Institute of International Business and Research (ASM IIBR) Punestarts with an eligibility check. This is followed by other selection rounds. These include application, selection, and admission confirmation. Students can check the below steps to complete theIIBR Pine admission process:
Application Process 2026

ASM IIBR application process is conducted in both online and offline modes. Candidates can either apply directly on the official website or download the application form and submit it at the college along with paying an application fee ofINR 1,000.Applicants must also submit their scorecard of Class 10 & 12, Graduation mark sheet, entrance exam scorecard, & photo ID proof either by email, by post or in person.
IIBR Pune Selection Rounds

ASM IIBR admissions are entrance-based. Candidates are offered admission based on various factors, which include qualifying for any one exam among CAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ ATMA/ MAT/ GMAT entrance exams and past academic background. Further, the final selection is based on candidates' performance in GD and PI rounds.
IIBR Pune Final Admission Confirmation

The institute sends a Selection Letter to the shortlisted students who have to report for verification of documents. To complete the process, students have to payIIBR Pune feeswithin the given deadline. After the process is completed, the institute provides confirmation letter.

placements.overview:
Harsha Institutions is a private institute located in Bangalore. Courses under the streams of Nursing, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Allied Health Sciences, Management, Paramedical, etc. at undergraduate and postgraduate levels are extended at the institute. Harsha Institutions has a College of Nursing, Pharmacy and Intsitute of Physiotherapy as some of the colleges affiliated with it and offer courses under it.

The flagship programmes offered at Harsha Institutions include BSc, UG Diploma, BBA and MBA, among others. These courses are offered in affiliation with Karnataka State Diploma Nursing Examination Board (KSDNEB) and Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS). Students can check the popular programmes offered at Harsha Institutions in the table provided below:

Harsha Institutions admission is both merit and entrance based. For a few courses, admissions are based on the merit of the last qualifying examination. On the other hand, for a few courses, admissions are granted on the basis of the entrance exams, such as KCET and Karnataka PGCET. faqs.answer: A:    The tuition fee structure for all Harsha Institutions courses including the BA courses is a per annum structure. The total tuition fees for BA courses at Harsha Institutions is around INR 5.85 Lacs with each 3 total instalments. Each instalment costs INR 1.95 Lacs and becomes due at the beginning of each year of the BA courses at Harsha Institutions.
faqs.question: What is the tuition fee structure for BA courses at Harsha Institutions?

faqs.answer: A:    Harsha Institutions BA courses do not require candidates to clear any entrance exams. Admissions into Harsha Institutions are merit based where the scores of a candidate in their last qualifying exam are taken into consideration to determine whether they get admission into the BA courses or not. Candidates only need to clear their Class 12 board exams for a recognised board.
faqs.question: Which entrance test scores are accepted by Harsha Institutions for BA?

faqs.answer: A:    No, the Harsha Institutions MBA cutoff for the year 2025 has not been released at this point. The cutoff list for entrance exams are released after the counseling rounds are over. The Harsha Institutions MBA admissions are decided through the scores of the Karnataka PGCET entrance exam. The counseling rounds of Karnataka PGCET are still ongoing at this point of time.
faqs.question: Has the cutoff for Harsha Institutions MBA course been announced for the 2025 session?

faqs.answer: A:    No, candidates are not required to possess a Bachelors degree in business to be able to gain admissions into MBA courses at Harsha Institutions. All candidates who manage to clear an undergraduate programme with a minimum aggregate of 50% should be able to apply for MBA admissions at Harsha Institutions. As long as the degree is offered by a UGC recognised institute, the candidate is eligible to apply for admissions.

Rajasthan Technical University has ten departments/centres that offer UG, PG and PhD courses in a wide range of specialisations. The admission process is different as per course requirements. As of now, the admission process for BTech is throughREAPcounselling, for MBA it is throughCMAT. However, students can check the admission process for MArch and MTech from the points mentioned below:

Admission Process-The admission process is divided into the following stages:Stage I: Online registration and fee payment,Stage II: Filling out the application form,Stage III: Seat allotment,Stage IV: Physical reporting and admission in the allotted institutes.
Stage One: Online registration and fee payment

A candidate is required to register online on CAM (Centralised Admission for MArch/MTech admission) website. Pay the application form fees of CAM, which is INR 3000 (INR 1500/for SC/ST category) this includes 18 % GST. Fees can be submitted online through any online payment gateway details. A candidate is required to pay any other admissible charges as per the requirement of online payment, as applicable. A transaction ID will be generated after the payment.
Stage Two: Filling out the application form

In order to activate the online application form by entering the required details, the candidate must enter the transaction ID in the appropriate column of the application form. Then thecandidate will be allowed to fill out the application form with their personal and academic details as per the requirements.
Stage Three: Online choice filling
All the valid registered candidates are required to exercise their choices of programs and institutes in order of their preference for these programs / Institutes.
Stage Four: Seat allotment

As per the tentative schedule, the choices submitted by the candidates will be processed centrally and seats will be allotted in the order of merit (as per the rules of merit) on the basis of the locked choices. The allotment of institute and specialization to the candidate will be carried out through the computer software by strictly following the order of merit, seats available, reservation rules and the order of options filled by the candidate.
Stage Five: Physical reporting & admission

A candidate, who has been allotted a seat shall required to report at the allotted institute as per the tentative schedule. A provisional seat allotment letter may be printed from the CAM-website using the login details.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee refund policy of GSFC University?
overview_faqs.answer: Students seeking cancellation of admission are eligible for refund of academic fee. review_summary.college_name: GSFC University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: This college has excellent infrastructure, superb laboratories, and well-maintained classes.

content.Placements: Approximately 60-70% of people have achieved good placements according to their grades and their capabilities. Around 80% of students got perfect jobs after graduation. The highest reported package is between 7 and 16 lakhs, approximately every year. Passing students have already achieved this previously and are also giving assurance to give their best in the future. Also, 80% of students achieve internships after each semester.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are very good from the student's point of view. Every requirement is fulfilled by them, and maintenance is performed on everything weekly. Wi-Fi and internet connection are out of the question; very precise. The library is very awesome, the classrooms are in excellent condition, etc. Hostel food quality is also maintained, and it is good to eat daily; hygiene is maintained.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: They provided good placements in 2024.

content.Placements: GSFC University gives 100% placements for every batch. Mostly 3 or 3.5 LPA is an average package for this course. Pharmaceutical companies are hiring for quality control and other department. GSFC University gives the best opportunities to students for the best internship.
content.Infrastructure: Excellent infrastructure of the university. The college has a good library, they also have Wi-Fi. Labs are very good and the environment is also good. There are well-maintained classrooms, advanced labs, and two libraries one in the School of Science is a central large library and another one is the School of Technology which is a small library and sports complexes. There are also two gyms in the campus area. There are hostels, a canteen, and a medical healthcare center also present on the university premises.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is good for fun and roaming.

content.Placements: For the 2025/26 B.Tech batch at GSFCU, placement rates are around 75-80%. The highest package is 8.5 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 4.5 LPA. Top recruiters include GSFC, Reliance, and Atul. 100% get internships (mostly at GSFC Ltd). Roles offered are Process/Site Engineer. Note: The placement cell is very strict.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is very bad on the entire campus. The hostel is separate for boys' (Vikram Sarabhai) and girls' (Kasturba Gandhi) buildings. Rooms are typically triple-sharing with attached washrooms, furnished with beds, study tables, and cupboards. Mess/Canteen serves healthy, varied meals 4 times a day. Food quality is rated highly compared to other hostels. The canteen offers multi-cuisine options.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure, decent placements, and faculty concerns.

content.Placements: 80-90% of placements are provided. 99% of students got internships from my court in well-known industries and pharmaceutical Industries like Sunpharma, Zydus, and Alembic. In particular, my course laboratories, faculty members, and teaching assistants provide help to every student.
content.Infrastructure: Labs, classrooms, library, canteen, medical facilities, sports, games everything is amazing at GSFC campus. The facilities available at GSFC University are top which helps students to beat their confirmzone far from their home. The campus is very good.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: GSFC University - A center for academic and personal growth.

content.Placements: In my course, more than 60% of students got placed. The average package offered in my course is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Reliance, Baxter, Sun Pharma, and Deepak Nitrite. Top roles offered are lab assistant, microbiologist, biotechnologist, and lab technician. The university also arranged a 2 days soft skills training program (CSDP) for all of us students to practice and learn how to be confident in interviews which helped me a lot in my career.
content.Infrastructure: There are many labs in the department of biosciences like molecular biology lab, microbiology lab, plant tissue culture lab, animal cell culture lab, and a general research lab. All the labs are equipped with state-of-the-art equipment which is calibrated regularly. The campus is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi and students are taught in smart classrooms. Library consists of all kinds of books and it is upgraded every month with new books and journals and is accessible till 11:00 PM at night. Hostel facility is really good at an affordable price. Food is tasty and hygienic. Also, it has a gym.

admission_process.title: GSFC University Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: GSFC University admission processstarts with registration, selection and admission confirmation. Students need to meet the eligibility to get a seat at the university. Students can submit the admission enquiry form online in case of any queries. Eligible candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat at GSFC University:
GSFC University Application Process
Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the university. Candidates need to pay an application fee as below to register for a course at the university.
Selection Rounds

GSFC University shortlists candidates based on national-level entrance exams such as GATE, JEE Main, etc. The university conducts theAdmission Competitive Test(ACT) for admission to some of the courses. Direct admission is also offered in some of the programmes to candidates who meet the specified criteria. Students looking to join through the state quota need to participate inACPC counsellingfor seat allotment.
Merit List andAdmission Confirmation

Once selection rounds are over, the university releases a merit list. Selected aspirants are allotted seats in the university. Candidates need to pay theGSFC University feeto confirm their seat at the university.

reviews.review_heading: This college has excellent infrastructure, superb laboratories, and well-maintained classes.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good from the student's point of view. Every requirement is fulfilled by them, and maintenance is performed on everything weekly. Wi-Fi and internet connection are out of the question; very precise. The library is very awesome, the classrooms are in excellent condition, etc. Hostel food quality is also maintained, and it is good to eat daily; hygiene is maintained.

reviews.review_heading: They provided good placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure of the university. The college has a good library, they also have Wi-Fi. Labs are very good and the environment is also good. There are well-maintained classrooms, advanced labs, and two libraries one in the School of Science is a central large library and another one is the School of Technology which is a small library and sports complexes. There are also two gyms in the campus area. There are hostels, a canteen, and a medical healthcare center also present on the unive...

reviews.review_heading: It is good for fun and roaming.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is very bad on the entire campus. The hostel is separate for boys' (Vikram Sarabhai) and girls' (Kasturba Gandhi) buildings. Rooms are typically triple-sharing with attached washrooms, furnished with beds, study tables, and cupboards. Mess/Canteen serves healthy, varied meals 4 times a day. Food quality is rated highly compared to other hostels. The canteen offers multi-cuisine options.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, decent placements, and faculty concerns.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, library, canteen, medical facilities, sports, games everything is amazing at GSFC campus. The facilities available at GSFC University are top which helps students to beat their confirmzone far from their home. The campus is very good.

reviews.review_heading: GSFC University - A center for academic and personal growth.
reviews.review_text: There are many labs in the department of biosciences like molecular biology lab, microbiology lab, plant tissue culture lab, animal cell culture lab, and a general research lab. All the labs are equipped with state-of-the-art equipment which is calibrated regularly. The campus is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi and students are taught in smart classrooms. Library consists of all kinds of books and it is upgraded every month with new books and journals and is accessible till 11:00 PM at night. Hos...

reviews.review_heading: It is an above-average college, but not that good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the university is well-maintained, though it is simplistic and less engaging due to a lack of vibrancy and modern aesthetics. Other amenities like Wi-Fi, computerized labs, non-air-conditioned but ventilated classrooms, a library, canteen, and gym are available in the university and are well-maintained. The hostel also has simple infrastructure. The hostel fee is Rs. 44,500, including facilities like washing machines per floor, joint bathrooms for all rooms, a mess providin...

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and facilities are really nice and all find it very friendly there.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very nice. The facilities provided there include Wi-Fi access. The labs are open 24X7 to work but you will need permission to work after the lab hours. They also have a library with AC where students. Faculty members can also read books in a calm environment without any disturbance. Classrooms are really good. About the hostel facilities, the food is really good both in the mess and canteen. There is also medical emergency center available for everyone. There is facility fo...

reviews.review_heading: A career in life science with GSFC can be exciting.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are very clean and the food is nice and healthy as compared to the other hostels nearby. Labs are open 24X7 for students to work on anything (with permission only). All the staff members are very supportive and encouraging. They are always there to support. For medical there is a whole building named health centre. There are various clubs running in university related to our interests.

reviews.review_heading: Internships at the end of every semester: A great catalyst for placement.
reviews.review_text: There is a building allocated to labs called 'Anviksha,' which has a great number of labs for each specialized subject. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and classrooms are very good and spacious. There is also a library that is abundant with great material. As for hostels, there are 3 hostels: 1 for girls and 2 for boys. All of them are neat and clean, and the living environment is great. Food in the mess is also good; in our hostel, a committee of students is formed that decides the menu for ...

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of GSFC University.
reviews.review_text: Good Wi-Fi is provided, labs are well maintained, all the devices in the lab are up-to-date, there are lifts provided, AC is provided in the lab, and there is a sitting area in our college named Sarjan. I have not opted for hostel but it's good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college, good teaching, and good vibes.
reviews.review_text: We have a very good infrastructure and environment. Canteen food is very tasty and healthy, medical facilities are good as there is a medical center on campus and sports courts like basketball, swimming pool, volleyball court, cricket ground, etc. are absolutely good.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are above average. Canteen food and even the hostel food are bad, even when students are paying a lot of money for this. They have the audacity to underfeed the students. Even breakfast is only a piece of bread without butter. Sports and games are organized properly, though.

reviews.review_heading: GSFC university review .
reviews.review_text: GSFC University has full Wi-Fi access. There is a separate building that houses all the laboratories, including computer labs, chemical labs, and biotech labs. The hostel provides good quality meals, including breakfast in the morning, lunch, an evening snack, and dinner. The canteen offers a variety of food dishes.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GSFC University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average. Our college provides us with all facilities. The hostel facilities are good. The hostel rooms are small. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. We have a gymnasium. A playground is available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for events and fests.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities. Many books are available in the library. Computer labs are available. Our classrooms are well equipped. The canteen is good. The quality of the food is good. A variety of dishes are available. Our college has a basketball court and a volleyball court.

review_summary.college_name: LNMU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications(BCA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: A budget friendly BCA college that focuses more on academics than placements.

content.Placements: In my batch, placements were average because CM College mainly focused on academics rather than corporate hiring. Around 10 to 15 percent of students got placed, mostly through off campus opportunities. Many students, including myself, chose to pursue higher studies like MCA or other masters programs after completing the course, because placement participation was limited.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of CM College was basic but functional. Classrooms were spacious and well ventilated. Though some needed modernization. Computer labs were available with sufficient systems for BCA students. Advanced software and the latest hardware needed improvement.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Political Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied with this college during my session 2022–2025.

content.Placements: 30% of students are placed in my course. The highest package is 12 LPA, and the lowest is 1 LPA offered in this course. Random companies recruit for this course. 60% of students get internships through our course. Most companies are related to professors, teachers, etc. in this course at my college.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi and labs are not available at my college, but classrooms are available. There are many classrooms in my college. All classrooms are open for students. The library is also available in my college for reading books and self-study.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. (Hons.) in Financial Accountancy - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall experience of my college life.

content.Placements: 65 percent of students got placement in my college last year. The highest package is around 15LPA and the average package is around 6LPA, and the lowest package is around 3.6LPA. They got opportunities from Big companies. Top roles offered were HRs and Accountants. Etc.
content.Infrastructure: Lack of Wi-Fi, not good infrastructure, the whole college old buildings need renovation, lack of smart class, teachers have to teach with traditional methods of writing on the board, etc. New Education Policy Books are not available in the library for many courses like ours. The college has a mess and canteen facility, but lacks medical facilities and many sports to play on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in History - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college as per the fees.

content.Placements: In this college, there are no placement criteria for the students, and no students get placed in this college. They do not provide any type of training for interviews, internships or placement. No companies have come to give interviews to the students, and no placements have been seen.
content.Infrastructure: Talking about their infrastructure overall, it was good that they provided a good classroom to their students, but they did not provide any type of canteen or medical facilities. But they provide sports games, and no library, Wi-Fi or labs are available for the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: APSM College, Barauni is an affiliated unit of Lalit Narayan Mithila University, Darbhanga.

content.Infrastructure: It is a nice college. The college emphasizes activities like sports, NCC, and NSS for the all-round development of the students. The campus is equipped with Wi-Fi. It has a library, language laboratory, and various counselling cell (career counselling, grievance, women empowerment, etc). It is located in Barauni, Begusarai district, Bihar. But there is no hostel facility.
content.Faculty: It is affiliated with Lalit Narayan Mithila University, Darbhanga. Faculty members help students in their learning and exam preparation. The council is run by various departments, and organized by seminars and conferences. All teachers are amazing, very supportive, and understand all the students in every academic area. APSM College follows stringent academic standards to provide quality education.
