admission_process.title: LNMU Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: LMNU course admissionis a multi-step process that requires the aspirants to appear for relevant entrance exams conducted either by the university or national-level entrance exams. The university also accepts students on a merit basis for some of its courses. Students seeking admission to any of the programmes offered at the university can follow the steps to complete theLalit Narayan Mithila Universityadmission process:
1. LNMU Application Process

Application forms are available online on the official website of the university. Candidates must fill the form before the last date to apply for admission. As admissions to a lot of courses are entrance-based, candidates must first appear for the relevant entrance exam before applying for the course.
2. Selection

LNMU shortlists students on the basis of the score secured by them in either the last qualifying exam or the entrance test. The university conducts its own Common Entrance Test and also accepts various national and state-level entrance tests, such as MAT/ CMAT, etc. Shortlisted students' names will be posted on the official website ofLalit Narayan Mithila University. Students can check out the merit list once it is posted online.
3. Fee Payment and Document Verification

Selected candidates will then be required to pay the admission confirmation fees to secure their admission atLNMU. Alternatively, forMBA admission at LNMU,students can also obtain the prescribed form and pay INR 1,000 through Cash/DD/ in favour of Director Management Courses, Department of Commerce & Business Administration, LNMU, accompanied by a bank draft of INR 1,050.

TheLNMU feevaries depending on the course and specialisation selected by the student. It includes variou components such as admission fees, tuition fees, application fees, etc. Some of these components are charged only once at the time of admission, while the remaining are to be paid either semesterly or yearly. Sports and extracurricular activities are limited, and students usually manage with what is pr...

faqs.answer: A:    Yes, candidates who have passed Class 10 and Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate and a minimum of 50% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, Maths/ Biology, and English in Class 12 can apply for BTech/ BTech (Hons) course with JEE Main or CUET score. Aspirants must secure at least 50 percentile for admission to through SAT India score. For aspirants who wish to apply with their merit in the last qualifying exam must pass Class 10 and Class 12 with at least 75%-80% aggregate and a minimum of 75%-80% aggregate in Class 12 PCM subjects.In case a candidate has not appeared for any of the specified exam, he or she can appear for UPESEAT. As soon as the selection round is over, aspirants will need to prove their eligibility by provding necessary documents for verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university. UPES BTech fee ranges between INR 9.46 Lacs and INR 18.32 Lacs as per an unofficial source. The fee is calculated based on tuition fee and does not includes other fee components.
faqs.question: Can I apply for UPES Dehradun BTech course after Class 12?

faqs.answer: A:    UPES (Admission Office) accepts various entrance exam scores for admission to different courses. For B.Tech. admissions, the university accepts UPESEAT, JEE, Board Merit, SAT, and CUET scores. For MBA admissions, the university accepts CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, NMAT, and UPESMET scores. Admission to M.Des. and B.Des. courses is based on the valid score of CEED or UPES DAT followed by a presentation and interview. BBA admission is done through UPESMET-UG and through National Level Tests. Admission for LLB courses is based on the score of ULSAT or CLAT/LSAT scores. faqs.question: How can I get admission to UPES - Experience Centre MBA course?
faqs.answer: UPES - Experience Centre admission to MBA course is based on either UPESMET/ CAT/ CUET PG scores. In case, an aspirant fails to secure the minimum marks specified by the university, he or she will need to appear for UPESMET. For admission to Global MBA, aspirants only need to come for the PI round. The shortlisted candidates will be called for group discussion and personal interview round for further selection. After completion of the selection rounds, aspirants will need to prove their eligibility by provding necessary documents for verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: Is it difficult to get admission in School of Health Sciences and Technology Courses, UPES - Experience Centre?
faqs.answer: Admission to UPES - Experience Centre can vary in difficulty depending on the chosen admission pathway. There are three options available: UPSEAT (which covers 80% of seats), Board marks (for which exceptional scores are required), and JEE Main marks for All India seats. If you are aiming for admission through UPSEAT, it's generally considered more competitive, and you should aim for a rank of at least 600 in the exam to increase your chances of securing a spot at the college. The difficulty level of admission can also be influenced by factors such as the number of applicants and the specific programme you are applying to. It's advisable to research the admission criteria and requirements for your chosen course to understand the level of competitiveness involved.

faqs.question: Does UPES - Experience Centre accept MAT score?
faqs.answer: No, the UPES - Experience Centredoes not accept the MAT score for MBA admissions. On the other hand, the UPES School of Business does accept the MAT score, with a minimum eligible MAT/CMAT 2024 score of 70 percentile exempting students from the UPES Management Entrance Test. Therefore, if you have a MAT score and are considering applying for an MBA at UPES, the School of Business would be the appropriate choice for your application.

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores are accepted by UPES (Admission Office) for admission?
faqs.answer: UPES (Admission Office) accepts various entrance exam scores for admission to different courses. For B.Tech. admissions, the university accepts UPESEAT, JEE, Board Merit, SAT, and CUET scores. For MBA admissions, the university accepts CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, NMAT, and UPESMET scores. Admission to M.Des. and B.Des. courses is based on the valid score of CEED or UPES DAT followed by a presentation and interview. BBA admission is done through UPESMET-UG and through National Level Tests. Admission for LLB courses is based on the score of ULSAT or CLAT/LSAT scores. The eligibility criteria and minimum marks required for different courses can be found on the UPES website

overview_faqs.question: What is the history of Rajasthan University? Does it have a good reputation?
overview_faqs.answer: University of Rajasthan is a public/ government university located in Jaipur, Rajasthan. It is one of the oldest universities in the state. It was set up in 1947 as the University of Rajasthan in 1956. Spread in approximately 705.0 acres on Jawaharlal Nehru Marg, also known as the central spine of Jaipur, the university has always accorded a high priority to games and sports. Uniraj has a modern sports complex, well-stocked library and well-equipped medical facilities to students. It is one of the renowned universities in India.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college is good, the teachers are helpful, classroom is nice.

content.Placements: 90% student workplace in our college. The highest package is 8 LPA, the average packages 3 LPA. Top recruiters who come to our campus are Wipro, Amazon, Flipkart, and IBM. 70 to 80% of students got internships in our course in high companies. The top role is web development, software engineer, data analysis, and business development.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are very Wi-Fi is available for every and each student. 3 labs are available in our college, and the library is very good, with all the books available in the library. The hostel quality is very well and the food is available in a mess, and the canteen is very tasty. The medical and sports game facilities are also very good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: Only 30% of students are placed in my college. The lowest is Rs.10,000 per month, and the highest is Rs. 40,000 per month. The Teleperformance company is the top recruiting company that previously come in my college. No one got an internship from our course. Only sales roles get offered in my course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is very poor. There are no facilities in my course or department. Wi-Fi is only available for teachers. There is no Wi-Fi available for students. There is no hostel facility in our college. About the quality of food, I don't know, because I'm not in a hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and highly qualified professors.

content.Placements: Basically, we have around 60 students in each class. I’m in the literature field, and we have great alumni from our field. They are now working in architecture companies, and many have become authors. They earn around 10 to 20 LPA. Our course generally focuses on the philosophy of great authors like Shakespeare and Tagore. I learn a lot from their learnings.
content.Infrastructure: The food here is great and edible. Mostly hostels don’t provide good food and facilities, but my hostel provides very nice food, and the facilities are also excellent. We have Wi-Fi to study, so there is no need for mobile data. Classrooms are somehow clean. My college also focuses on sports and the development of children.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely the best college in Rajasthan because of placement, facilities, and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Placements are excellent. About 35% students in every batch are selected into their further branch for upcoming studies. There are no packages in medical studies. Here, we considered a seat in postgraduate colleges as placement. Overall, this college is best for upcoming studies and placements.
content.Infrastructure: Our college was opened in 1992, and since its opening, every batch has done well in studies in their era due to the college's best infrastructure for the MBBS course. There are different labs in every department. Labs are in good condition. There is a central library, where students come and study quietly.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Overall, a very good college in this area.

content.Placements: There was no placement for B.Sc. students. You have to do it yourself. Placements were open only for commerce and engineering students. Majorly, Tisco came for an interview and placement. Top roles were something 35 LPA, but only for top qualified students. Average students get only a 10-15 thousand per month package.
content.Infrastructure: A great campus, garden, lawn, playground, everything was included. 2 movie songs were shot in my time. You will get a 100-student seating capacity library with Wi-Fi + digital library and student corners also. All labs were well furnished. The classroom was also in good condition. Proper seating, well-lit, fans, but not air-conditioned.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Really good infrastructure with decent academics but the best atmosphere to study.

review_content.Placements: I am a fresher from the BBA course at Ravenshaw University. Based on what I observed from seniors, placements are average. Around 40 to 50% of students get placed with packages mostly in the range of 2 to 3 LPA. Higher packages up to 5-6 LPA are rare. Companies visiting are mostly local firms and small private organizations. Internship opportunities are available, mainly in sales, marketing, and basic management roles. The university provides decent infrastructure and a learning environment for beginners. I have seen TCS, ICICI, and Jindal Steel; this type of company offers constant roles and HR roles.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Information Technology and Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Ravenshaw University: A legacy of learning, leadership and heritage campus with strong academics.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of placement in my course in my university is around 30 to 40 percent. The highest package offered is 6 LPA and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA in my course. The companies are ICICI Bank, Accenture, TCS, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, etc. The internship percentage is 10 percent and below. The companies that offer internships are like Infosys, Bhubaneswar local companies, etc. As this course includes management, roles like management opportunities and HR post, and also coding post below engineers and clerical post are also given in my course.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Information Technology and Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied because of good placements at companies like Infosys, TCS, Cognizant, etc.

review_content.Placements: The highest package is 14 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Cognizant, TCS, Infosys, and other reputable companies come here. 70% of students got internships from this course. This course is also budget-friendly. For 3years, 2 LPA-2.5 LPA is spent but will be worth it.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel's mess food is good. Better than average but a little bit less than good. Canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games, everything is available on our campus and hostel also. Computer labs are equipped with Wi-Fi. The library is also present.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: A really good college, absolutely satisfied.

review_content.Placements: Around 80% of BBA students were placed in our course. The highest salary package was 6 LPA, the lowest being 2 LPA, and the average being 2.6- 2.62 LPA. Top recruiters being Deloitte, Accenture, TCS, ICICI Bank, Wipro, Infosys, Genpact, EY, SBI Life, etc. 50 to 65% students receive internships in companies like Bajaj Finance, where roles offered include Assistant and HR associate. Top roles offered by our course are Call Centre Executive, Finance specialists, HR Assistant, Marketing associates, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The department is located on the west side of the campus near VC residence and is well equipped with AC and smart classrooms. The depth also consists of a library. Hostel facility is not available for self financing students on our campus. Ravenshaw University has a good mess and canteen facility. High internet speed, campus sports and games facilities, and libraries like Kanika Library and Centenary, and also e resources.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: A very good and beautiful university to study and upgrade your skills.

review_content.Placements: Good placements are available, and the university offers attractive packages. Many opportunities are provided for placements, with starting salaries ranging from around 25,000 to 35,000–45,000. Several renowned companies participate in the placement process.
review_content.Infrastructure: Good and better facilities in the building and hostel with better sanitation and low fees to survive. The infrastructure is very good, with proper bedrooms, chairs, tables, mosquito nets, an Acquaguard facility, a garden, and many more facilities provided in the hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc.(Hons.) in Information Technology and Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Of course, Ravenshaw University name is enough to judge.

review_content.Placements: It opens doors to various roles in the IT field, including software developer, programmer, and technical consultant. Other potential career paths include project manager, data analyst, business analyst, and web developer. ITM graduates can find opportunities in banks, insurance companies, public sectors, and private companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is nice. But there are no air-conditioned classrooms. Free Wi-Fi is there all over the campus. There is hostel facility for girls. While hostel facilities are not provided for boys, affordable housing is available nearby. A canteen is available on campus. ITM department also organizes inter-university events. It has its own library where you can issue books upto 14 days.

content.Placements: I am a fresher from the BBA course at Ravenshaw University. Based on what I observed from seniors, placements are average. Around 40 to 50% of students get placed with packages mostly in the range of 2 to 3 LPA. Higher packages up to 5-6 LPA are rare. Companies visiting are mostly local firms and small private organizations. Internship opportunities are available, mainly in sales, marketing, and basic management roles. The university provides decent infrastructure and a learning environment for beginners. I have seen TCS, ICICI, and Jindal Steel; this type of company offers constant roles and HR roles.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2027

individual_reviews.title: University is good and satisfied with the facilities.

content.Placements: There are no maximum placements, but education is good. Placements are too low so that's why their NAC is B+. individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: My Review of this college.

content.Placements: Placement cell of our college is very good, but it is limited to a few courses. Very few companies visit for Science courses, which is obvious as Science students have more options through entrance or after post-graduation. Placement cell for humanities and commerce students is performing quite well, with an average package of around 5 LPA and the highest up to 15 LPA. Some companies that approached Science students are TCL, Infosys, Wipro, eBay, Macleods, Cipla, Sun Pharma, etc. They offered a starting salary of 30,000 to 50,000. There is a 50 percent recruitment rate.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Commerce (M.Com.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Punctual in everyday programs.

content.Placements: The maximum opportunities approaching the college for recruitment were financial assistant, BDA, and accounting executive. Maximum students choose to work in the role of BDA due to higher pay, and they were usually paid above INR 3.6 LPA. As of 2023, 63% of students got placed in various MNCs and moderate companies.
content.Infrastructure: College fixed several teams and some responsibilities, so each of the team do something at their best like arranging some special events, webinars, etc. But they failed to communicate this with one another which created a lot of confusion at the end. Other than this college was so punctual in their everyday programs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I recommend taking admission in this university.

content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure and hostel are good, compared to other colleges, it is good. The hostel is very good, but the temperature is often very hot. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: This university is the best for admission.

content.Placements: Although this course is new in this university, as previously there was a B.Sc. Computer Science and not B. Tech. There has been an average number of placements in B.Sc. Batch and B.Teach, the first batch is yet to be completed. This AI ML course has very interesting topics to learn.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities provided here, I would say, are average. New hostels are being made for newcomers, and Wi-Fi and CCTV facilities are also being provided. Other than that, the university is full of greenery (just not in the summer season). Classrooms are also equipped with working air conditioning and smart boards. Several games are being played here, and the most prominent are football and volleyball. The mess food is very bad. faqs.question: Are admissions at Central University of Karnataka entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: Admissions at Central University of Karnataka (CUK) are mostly entrance-based, except for some courses. For most of the UG and PG programs, you need to appear for the Central Universities Common Entrance Test (CUET), which is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to 12 central universities.For B.Tech and M.Tech programs, you need to have valid JEE Main and GATE scores, respectively. For PhD programs, you need to qualify for a written entrance test and a personal interview conducted by CUK. You also need to meet the eligibility criteria of the course, such as having a minimum percentage of marks in the qualifying exam. You can check the details of the admission process and the eligibility criteria for different courses on the official website of CUK or on the websites of CUET UG and CUET PG, the entrance exams conducted by the university.
